0022600214.text: The Utah Jazz (1-9, on an eight-game losing streak) host the Miami Heat (4-6, winners of their last game) in the Jazz's 11th game of the season, with Utah 1-4 at home and 15th in the West, while Miami sits 8th in the East. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain), and Keyonte George is listed as day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and their 2025-26 series was split 1-1, with the Jazz winning the most recent meeting 115-111 in Miami on February 9, 2026.
